exps.title: PFA Internship — Agentic AI for BOM Management
exps.desc: Designed an automated nomenclature management system based on agentic AI. Built a Power BI dashboard to analyze BOM anomalies, and developed an Agentic AI System with Groq LLM and Python to compare BOM/mBOM, auto-generate reports, send email alerts, and provide an interactive dashboard for anomaly investigation.

exps.title: Internship — Automated PV Sizing Tool
exps.desc: Developed an Excel (VBA) tool for automated on-grid/off-grid PV sizing. Built a multi-brand component database with Power BI and Python scripts for automatic equipment selection.

exps.title: Internship & Final Project (DUT)
exps.desc: Dimensioned a 62 kWp PV installation for a 57-ha farm using PVsyst, AutoCAD for electrical schematics, SketchUp for 3D site modeling. Installed a 10 kW solar pumping system.

projs.d: Automated vertical farming: SolidWorks 3D, ESP32 IoT dashboard, EasyEDA/Proteus schematics, YOLOv8 detection + ResNet classification for lettuce health monitoring. Presented at Hult Prize ENSA Fès.
Industrial monitoring: Arduino (C++), EEPROM, matrix keypad & safety relay. Active cooling + thermal sensors. Live Python Dash dashboard for predictive maintenance.
On-grid 15 kW system: 26 Jinko panels, Huawei inverter, Siemens variator, 3 kW pump. Monthly savings ~2,137 DH, ROI 1.9 years, 27.2 MWh/year.
48h sprint: SolidWorks + AutoCAD 3D reconstruction of ENSA Fès conference room. COMSOL Multiphysics simulation: airflow, surface pressure, thermal comfort & wind resistance.
Mobile app for farmers — Ramadan IA Hackathon 2026. 4th place, only market-ready project. Covers crop selection, disease treatment & market access.
35+ SolidWorks mechanical parts & assemblies. Full AutoCAD 2D technical blueprints ready for industrial manufacturing.
Retail analytics: customer segmentation, product performance, geographic mapping, gender analysis and multi-year KPI tracking.
Intelligent heating system simulated with Proteus, plus Python analysis of temperature data to optimise energy consumption. (Dec 2025)
Interactive dashboard on cinema attendance and revenue over decades: admissions by film origin, weekday attendance and year-by-year trends.
